Name: (CP) Simple Foliage Stardew Valley Expanded Patch (SVE)
Author: SeaSea50
Description:
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/ZxMrNps/mod-details-1.png[/img]

When playing with SVE I got a bit peeved when during the reveal of the Enchanted Grove the tree changed from the Simple Foliage Style back to the vanilla tree style, if that bothered you too this is the patch for you!

This is a retexture for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ that retexture's some tilesheets to match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿ artstyle! (for the 1.6 update you can find it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]here[/url]﻿).

I may slowly retexture some other SVE assets to match the style more[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]For a RSV patch checkout  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/63034786]1oOwOo1[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42292]Simple Foliage - Ridgeside Village mod[/url]


Let me know if there's any bugs!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/JtMTbjw/installation.png<img src=[/img]

This is a Content Patcher mod so it goes in your mods folder to work. Here's a step by step process:

 
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have downloaded the requirements

[/*]
[*]Download and unzip this mod and then drop into your mods folder

[/*]
[*]You're all done![/*]
[*]

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/HtmBT4b/compatibility-1.png[/img][/url]

This only mildly edits the Enchanted Grove Tree tilesheet area so far, so it will be compatibile with any recolour or building retexture
:)[/*]
[/list]A Desaturated sprite in the style of VPR has been added to work with the[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14928] Redraw Pelican Town Expanded (VPR)[/url]﻿ Mods edited Enchanted Grove Tilesheet. Although it can work with any recolour.

Thank you Flashshifter and the rest of the SVE team for the open asset use permission. Couldn't have made this without the mod :) Checkout the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Main Mod[/url]﻿!

Original assets goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/73472878]dugongkebalik[/url]/itsanette for open asset permissions as long as you are DM when you plan to release said mod. Checkout the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Main Mod[/url]﻿!


Can't forget to thank ConcernedApe for making Stardew Valley :)[/center]
